answer.label: In short
answer.lead: Amazon ads management is the work of running sponsored ads on Amazon and improving the listings they send shoppers to, so the ad spend turns into profitable sales.
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) runs Amazon ads for D2C brands, including The Growing Giraffe, alongside their website and other channels.

points.title: Ads that follow stock

leaks.note: Screens are illustrative recreations of each platform's interface, not client data. Platform names and logos belong to their owners.
leaks.lede: On Amazon the ad, the listing and the stock work as one system. Each stage below is where it breaks, and how we run it.

stages.breaks: Advertising a listing that does not convert.
stages.why: Ads send shoppers to your listing. A weak title, images or price wastes every click.
stages.does: We improve titles, bullet points, images and rich content, so the traffic you pay for has a reason to buy.

stages.breaks: One campaign with every keyword mixed together.
stages.why: Mixed campaigns hide which keywords earn and which drain budget.
stages.does: We separate campaigns by purpose (defending brand terms, finding new ones, targeting products) and set a budget for each.

stages.breaks: Running ads on products that are low or out of stock.
stages.why: Advertising stock you cannot fulfil wastes spend and can harm rankings and the customer's trust.
stages.does: We plan ads around inventory, and pause or shift spend when availability changes.

stages.breaks: A bare listing with nothing to build trust.
stages.why: Shoppers compare on Amazon. A clear brand store and rich content signal a brand worth buying.
stages.does: We build brand stores and rich content that present the range clearly and support the ads.

stages.breaks: Judging Amazon ads on ad-attributed sales alone.
stages.why: Ads also lift sales that Amazon does not attribute to them. Reading only attributed sales misjudges what the ads do.
stages.does: We read ad performance alongside total sales and your margin, so budgets follow what actually adds profit.
